intro: Selected brand books. Every one starts with a brief, moves through pencil sketches, and ends as a system the client can use for years.

studies.name: SPACES
studies.description: A bold and modular brand identity for a multi-sector company operating across fuel distribution, logistics, and property development. The visual system balances structure with movement, built for long-term scalability across industries.

studies.name: GLOBESTAR Express
studies.description: A bold and structured brand identity for a US-based freight and transportation company. The system combines authority, precision and fleet-scale presence, a strong visual foundation built for the road.

studies.name: iPetStar
studies.description: A clear and trustworthy brand system for a pet services platform, focused on clarity, usability and structure across the app, web and everyday touchpoints.

studies.name: Microapp.io
studies.description: A bold and cohesive brand identity for a tech-forward SaaS platform. The system merges futuristic visuals, structured UI elements and a strong grid-based design, a modern and scalable foundation for digital products.

studies.name: QFL
studies.industry: Qazaqstan Football League · Broadcast TV Experience
studies.description: A high-impact logo, branding and broadcast identity for a national football league, blending tradition, performance and dynamic visual storytelling across TV and digital platforms.

studies.name: UK smiles
studies.description: A structured brand identity system built for a high-end dental experience, focused on trust, clarity and patient confidence.

studies.name: Saliencia
studies.description: A clean and confident brand identity for a multi-sector company operating across fuel distribution and lifestyle. The brand sits at the intersection of energy and culture, built for those who move with purpose.

studies.name: DETOUR
studies.description: A structured brand identity system for Detour Coffee, focused on clarity, consistency and strong visual presence across all touchpoints. The concept captures movement, direction and everyday exploration through a clean, geometric, scalable design system.

studies.name: Aoodor
studies.description: A modern and modular brand identity for a smart-living company offering a wide range of outdoor and home products. The visual system emphasises clarity, functionality and warmth, reflecting the brand's mission to simplify everyday living through smart design.

studies.name: Farfalla
studies.description: A warm, elegant brand identity for a specialty café in Astana that blends artisanal coffee culture with refined, nature-inspired aesthetics.

studies.name: Soul Search
studies.description: A heartfelt and elegant brand identity for a premium matchmaking platform based in Chicago, helping high-profile clients find meaningful relationships.

studies.name: Recrewer
studies.description: A bold and versatile brand identity for a global recruitment platform focused on streamlining remote hiring. Logo design, brand guidelines, motion concept, colour system, dark mode optimisation and UI-ready branding assets for digital onboarding and social media.

studies.name: Shepherd & Grace
studies.description: A sophisticated brand identity for a UAE-based luxury jewelry brand that blends timeless elegance with modern refinement.

studies.name: Aliyz
studies.description: A modern, resilient brand identity for a U.S. metal engineering company focused on precision fabrication, welding and CNC machining solutions.

studies.name: W’Ink
studies.description: A brand identity and pitch deck for an immersive tattoo convention concept developed in Milan, blending creativity, business strategy and cultural innovation.

studies.name: Winged Pony
studies.description: A heartfelt and unique brand identity for a Dutch leathercraft business inspired by two mini ponies, specialising in custom-made bitless bridles that celebrate freedom, individuality and the connection between horse and rider.

studies.name: BOX caffee
studies.description: A clear and trustworthy brand system for a caffee bar, focused on clarity, usability and structure.

studies.name: Pickle & Pin
studies.description: A premium brand identity for a modern pickleball and golf club in Grand Rapids, blending social energy with sport and upscale leisure aesthetics.

studies.name: Kave Sales Inc.
studies.description: A structured brand identity system built for an industrial fabrication company, focused on precision, strength and real-world application.

studies.name: Cortado
studies.description: A purposeful brand identity focused on clarity, structure and usability. Designed for a modern coffee experience, built for consistency.

studies.name: m/eleven
studies.description: m/eleven is a visual studio focused on photography, video and storytelling. The identity translates their personal story into a minimal, timeless mark built around the m and 11.
